content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text decides a link collision involving Acts 2:30 by comparing the defender's chain answer with the challenger's chain press.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "neither chain forces the other.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "'weighs chain against chain by footing' — I weighed whether the judge had to show an explicit footing comparison or whether a chain-vs-chain underdetermination finding suffices.", "why": "The judge compared the defender's chain answer with the challenger's chain press and found neither forces the other, without using a verse-by-verse stating-verse test."}
